Field & Integration Engineer 
 Bucharest, Romania | Advanced Technology & Defense Systems 
 Are you an engineer who prefers being in the field rather than behind a desk?
 We are looking for a Field & Integration Engineer to join a highly skilled engineering team delivering advanced mission-critical systems across international projects. This is a hands-on role that combines system integration, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, customer interaction, and field operations in a dynamic and technologically advanced environment.
 This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working directly with customers, traveling internationally, and seeing their work deployed in real-world operational environments.
 What You Will Be Doing: 
Integrate complex hardware and software systems and subsystems
Install, configure, test, and validate equipment in laboratory and field environments
Execute system verification, validation, performance, and acceptance testing
Support customer deployments, commissioning activities, and operational readiness
Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and system-level issues
Perform root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions
Participate in customer demonstrations, evaluations, FATs, SATs, and acceptance activities
Collaborate closely with Software, Hardware, Systems Engineering, Production, and Project Management teams
Prepare technical reports, integration documentation, and test records
Deliver technical support during deployment and operational phases
Conduct operator and customer training when required
 What We Are Looking For: 
Technical background in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Systems, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Telecommunications, or a related field
Experience in system integration, testing, technical support, commissioning, field engineering, or similar hands-on engineering roles
Troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities
Ability to understand technical drawings, specifications, procedures, and engineering documentation
Experience working with multidisciplinary systems involving hardware, software, communication, and control components
Excellent English communication skills
Valid driver's license
Comfortable working independently in both laboratory and field environments
Willingness to travel extensively and support international projects
 Nice to Have: 
Experience in defense, aerospace, industrial automation, automotive, telecommunications, or complex engineering systems
Experience with commissioning, FAT, SAT, or customer acceptance testing
Military technical background or experience supporting operational systems
Familiarity with measurement equipment, diagnostic tools, and automation technologies
Exposure to international projects and multicultural environments
Additional foreign languages
 If you enjoy building, testing, troubleshooting, integrating, and deploying complex systems around the world, we'd love to hear from you.
 📩 Apply directly or contact us for a confidential discussion.
 In full compliance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970, please note that the applicable salary range defined by our client for this role will be disclosed to candidates by our consulting team within a reasonable timeframe before the interview process begins.
 All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.
